summary: Tested job description formatting feature. All 12 backend tests passed validating the formatJobDescription.js utility and FormattedJobDescription.jsx component. Code review confirms section header detection (Requirements, The Community You Will Join, etc.), bullet point rendering with indigo styling, and proper spacing. Frontend UI testing was limited due to job search API latency (streaming external APIs), but code analysis confirms all formatting elements are correctly implemented.

Proper spacing using space-y-3 and space-y-1.5 classes
Dashboard.jsx and JobSearch.jsx both import and use FormattedJobDescription with expand/collapse toggle
Scrollable container (max-h-96 overflow-y-auto) correctly wraps description content
